evidence: WHAT IS DONE WELL: every interactive/time-varying promise in the brief is driven by real actions and waits, not a first paint. Live board (instruction.md:5, rules s5) -> functional hro_live_board (judge.toml:296-302) + protocol V (prompt.md:55) and polish hro_pol_live_board (polish judge.toml:47-54): open card details, type an unsaved note, scroll, another recruiter moves a card in an independent context, then read details/note value/document.activeElement/scroll offset and type more. Conversations: hro_msg_exchange, hro_unread_counts, hro_seen, hro_unread_scrolled_up (functional judge.toml:304-365) are timed observations; hro_pol_live_thread types a reply then waits for Noor's message; hro_pol_earlier_place measures getBoundingClientRect().top before/after loading earlier messages; hro_thread_latest/hro_thread_earlier click 'earlier' repeatedly; hro_msg_compose presses Shift+Enter/Enter and reads focus; hro_drafts switches conversation/Board/reload; hro_pol_session_resume ends the session in a second tab and presses Send; hro_pol_failed_send aborts one request; hro_refused_put_back reads document.activeElement after a refused optimistic move. Timing follows lessons 7/14: functional prompt.md:19-21 and polish prompt.md:16-18 run each timed step in one browser_run_code_unsafe action, t0 after a successful trigger, 500 ms polling up to 15000 ms, no interaction on the observed page, void = error before t0 or failed trigger, at most two repeats, met:false is final. Lesson 8: app_context.md:33-35 tells the judge to hold modifiers during the click. Lesson 9: 'Report every step' in all three scored prompts (functional prompt.md:23-25). Lesson 13: only localhost addresses. Viewport/theme: instruction.md:11 says no theme switching or phone layout; visual prompt.md:104 assesses a conventional desktop viewport, so no resize/toggle is owed. Gates stay simple load/reload/shared-storage (lesson 4). DEFECT (negative time-varying legs are not told to wait): the shared timed-observation rule (functional prompt.md:21) ends reading 'until the expected change is present or 15000 ms have passed'. Several U legs expect something NOT to change after another person's action, and no step says to hold the reading for the window: hro_seen 'after only the Observer opens the conversation it is still not seen' (judge.toml:364; protocol U prompt.md:49 'Aud opens the conversation: still not seen'); hro_unread_counts 'while it is open at its newest message Tomas's next message does not raise his count or total' (judge.toml:346; U: 'it appears, and Rafael's count and total do not rise'); hro_unread_scrolled_up 'stays unread until he goes to it' (judge.toml:355). Read literally, the 'expected' state (not seen / count unchanged) is already present at t0, so met=true at ~0 ms and the judge scores a still snapshot taken before any polled or pushed update could land. The brief explicitly allows polling within 15 s (rules s5 line 127), so an app whose updates land seconds later is legitimate, and its wrong late update would be invisible. Evidence level: scripted golden observations only (workspace.json groups 12, 13, 18-20, 22 passed; live arrival_ms 809). No configured judge run, judge transcript or weak-app discrimination run exists for these legs (raw-evidence-index scope says so), so how the judge interprets the negative legs is unmeasured; risk stays true irrespective of the defect.
counterexample: Broken app that passes hro_seen (weight 1.5): it polls every 5 s and wrongly counts the Observer's opening as 'seen'. In U, Aud opens the conversation in her context (t0); the judge's loop reads Rafael's page at t0 and finds 'not seen' present -> met:true, ms~0, returns. Five seconds later Rafael's page would have shown 'Seen' from Aud's open, but nobody looks. Tomas then opens -> 'Seen' appears -> every leg recorded as passing. Same shape for hro_unread_counts: an app that raises Rafael's count for a message arriving in the open, at-newest conversation on its separate 5 s badge poll passes because the count is read at the instant the message bubble appears. Conversely a conforming app is not at risk; the defect is over-crediting.
suggested_fix: In functional prompt.md 'Timed observations' (and U), add: for a step that expects something NOT to change after another person's action (still not seen after the Observer opens; count/total do not rise; stays unread while scrolled up), make the forbidden change the watched condition, keep reading for the full 15000 ms, and pass that leg only if met is false.
